name: proton-drive-mcp
description: Give Claude access to your Proton Drive: list, upload, download, share and manage end-to-end encrypted files via the official proton-drive CLI.
long_description:
Upload, download, search, share, move, trash and manage your Proton Drive files and photos from Claude Desktop. This extension wraps the official proton-drive CLI, so files stay end-to-end encrypted and nothing goes through a third-party relay.

Requires the official proton-drive CLI to be installed and signed in (run `proton-drive auth login` once). Enter the path to the CLI in the settings field below: run `which proton-drive` in a terminal (usually ~/.local/bin/proton-drive).

proton_drive_bin.title: proton-drive CLI path
proton_drive_bin.description: Path to the official proton-drive CLI. Run `which proton-drive` in a terminal to find it; usually ~/.local/bin/proton-drive. Leave empty to search PATH (Claude Desktop's PATH is minimal, so setting this is recommended).

sync_path.title: Proton Drive sync folder
sync_path.description: Optional. Root of your locally synced Proton Drive folder; enables drive_read_file and drive_write_file.

tools.name: drive_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the Proton Drive CLI has an active authenticated session.

tools.name: drive_auth_logout
tools.description: Clear the stored Proton Drive session from the OS keychain.

tools.name: drive_version
tools.description: Return the installed proton-drive CLI version and SDK version as {cli: string, sdk: string}.

tools.name: drive_list
tools.description: List the immediate children of a Proton Drive folder.

tools.name: drive_tree
tools.description: Show a Proton Drive folder as a tree with per-folder file counts and size totals.

tools.name: drive_search
tools.description: Find files and folders under a Proton Drive path by name, type, extension, size or modified date.

tools.name: drive_info
tools.description: Get full metadata for a single Proton Drive file or folder, including latest revision details.

tools.name: drive_upload
tools.description: Upload a local file or folder to Proton Drive with end-to-end encryption.

tools.name: drive_download
tools.description: Download a file or folder from Proton Drive to the local filesystem.

tools.name: drive_mkdir
tools.description: Create a new empty folder on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_rename
tools.description: Rename a file or folder in place on Proton Drive, without moving it to a different parent folder.

tools.name: drive_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file or folder on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or folder that is already in the Proton Drive trash — irreversible.

tools.name: drive_share_status
tools.description: Return the current sharing state of a Proton Drive path.

tools.name: drive_list_trash
tools.description: List all files and folders currently in the Proton Drive trash.

tools.name: drive_share_invite
tools.description: Invite a person to access a Proton Drive file or folder by email.

tools.name: drive_share_revoke
tools.description: Remove a specific person's access to a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_trash
tools.description: Move a file or folder to the Proton Drive trash.

tools.name: drive_sync_plan
tools.description: Read-only plan: compare a local folder with a Proton Drive folder (nothing is transferred).

tools.name: drive_bulk_move
tools.description: Move many items into one Proton Drive folder; returns a plan first, applies only with confirmed=true.

tools.name: drive_bulk_trash
tools.description: Trash many items on Proton Drive (recoverable); returns a plan first, applies only with confirmed=true.

tools.name: drive_restore
tools.description: Restore a trashed file or folder back to its original Proton Drive path.

tools.name: drive_empty_trash
tools.description: Permanently delete ALL items in the Proton Drive trash — irreversible, no recovery.

tools.name: drive_copy
tools.description: Copy a file or folder to another location on Proton Drive.

tools.name: drive_list_invitations
tools.description: List all pending sharing invitations from other Proton Drive users.

tools.name: drive_invitation_accept
tools.description: Accept a pending Proton Drive sharing invitation.

tools.name: drive_invitation_reject
tools.description: Reject a pending Proton Drive sharing invitation.

tools.name: drive_share_leave
tools.description: Leave a Proton Drive folder that was shared with you by another user.

tools.name: drive_share_set_url
tools.description: Create or update a public share link for a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_share_remove_url
tools.description: Remove the public share link from a Proton Drive file or folder.

tools.name: drive_share_remove_all
tools.description: Remove access for every member and every pending invitation (Proton and non-Proton) on a shared Proton Drive path, in a single call.

tools.name: photos_list_albums
tools.description: List all photo albums in Proton Photos.

tools.name: photos_create_album
tools.description: Create a new empty photo album in Proton Photos.

tools.name: photos_update_album
tools.description: Rename an album or change its cover photo in Proton Photos.

tools.name: photos_delete_album
tools.description: Delete a Proton Photos album.

tools.name: photos_list_album_photos
tools.description: List the photos in a Proton Photos album.

tools.name: photos_add_to_album
tools.description: Add a photo from your Proton Photos library to an album.

tools.name: photos_remove_from_album
tools.description: Remove a photo from a Proton Photos album without deleting it from your library.

tools.name: photos_list_timeline
tools.description: List photos in your Proton Photos timeline (your full photo library, not scoped to an album).

tools.name: photos_download
tools.description: Download one or more photos from your Proton Photos timeline to a local folder by their /photos/<name> path.

tools.name: photos_upload
tools.description: Upload one or more local photo or video files directly into your Proton Photos library (My Photos timeline).

tools.name: drive_read_file
tools.description: Read the text contents of a file from the local Proton Drive sync folder.

tools.name: drive_write_file
tools.description: Write text content to a file in the local Proton Drive sync folder (no Proton login needed — this only touches the local synced folder).

tools.name: drive_usage
tools.description: Storage analytics for a Proton Drive path: totals, largest files and folders, breakdowns, old files and trash.

tools.name: drive_find_duplicates
tools.description: Find likely duplicate files in Proton Drive (claimed sha1, same size, or hash-verified); suggests a keeper, never deletes.

tools.name: drive_sharing_audit
tools.description: Audit public links, invitees and risk flags across shared items in Proton Drive.
